source: backend/ocr/ocr_v2_bridge_config.py default_ocr_v2_bridge_config() + statement governance + R2 remediation

assumptions.note: Lucky pagination. Basis is stated in statement headers ('Unconsolidated'/'Consolidated') -> derivable without page ranges.
Lucky pagination. Statement type derivable from statement titles + 'Notes to' markers + analysis-section headers.
Lucky investee note pages (NutriCo/ASIL). Derivable but harder: requires entity-name detection / MSIL identity on investment-note tables.

assumptions.lucky_value: turnover->revenue, gross profit->gross_profit, net cash from operating activities->operating_cash_flow, share capital & reserves->total_equity, long-term financing->long_term_debt, ... (+OCR-garble variants)
assumptions.note: Standard financial-statement vocabulary; applies to any issuer. The OCR-garble variants are noise patterns, not issuer-specific. REUSABLE.
Section-header markers are issuer-independent; this is already a generic document-derived rule.

assumptions.lucky_value: page 162 + 'Long term finance' (2020-25) -> long_term_debt_summary_reference; page 162 + 'Net Cash from Operating Activities' (2024-25) -> operating_cash_flow_summary_reference
assumptions.note: Most over-fit: hardcoded to Lucky page 162 + specific years; 'source-reference guards from the CV1 Lucky truth set'. Not derivable; pure Lucky tuning.
Issuer-independent governance logic (the general core). REUSABLE as-is.

assumptions.lucky_value: label the unlabeled subtotal immediately before TOTAL EQUITY AND LIABILITIES as total_liabilities
assumptions.note: Structural/positional; issuer-independent in principle BUT fragile: Millat's standalone BS has no such unlabeled subtotal, so it correctly yields SOURCE_INSUFFICIENT. Over-fit-prone; must be validated cross-issuer.
Dedup MECHANISM (camelot vs pdfplumber double-extraction) is generic; the PAGE LIST is Lucky-specific. Dedup should key on (value,year,provenance), not a page list.
Per-document; expected to vary by bundle (not a defect, but confirms single-document binding).

summary_counts.dominant_blocker: A1/A2/A3 page ranges + A6 page/year aliases -> these are what make an unseen issuer collapse to UNKNOWN tags

current_support.evidence: default_ocr_v2_bridge_config() is a single Lucky config; page ranges + page/year aliases + dedup pages are Lucky-hardcoded; no config-selection mechanism; Millat collapses (UNKNOWN tags) without a Millat config.

A_per_issuer_configs.operational_burden: high (manual config per issuer + per filing-year pagination drift)
A_per_issuer_configs.validation: each issuer config + truth set must be validated; config itself is unvalidated over-fit-prone input
A_per_issuer_configs.production_suitability: low (does not scale to arbitrary issuers/filings)

B_generic_document_derived.effort: high (derive basis/statement_type from headers+markers; entity_scope from entity resolution; dedup generically)
B_generic_document_derived.validation: validate the derivation once across multiple issuers; generalization is the tested property
B_generic_document_derived.production_suitability: high (scales to unseen issuers; the platform goal)

C_hybrid.effort: medium (generic derivation as default + retain bounded per-issuer override for hard cases)
C_hybrid.validation: validate generic derivation cross-issuer; overrides are logged exceptions, individually validated; bounded over-fit

final_determination.recommended_form: C_hybrid (generic document-derived bridge + bounded validated per-issuer overrides)
final_determination.feasibility_note: Generic path is feasible: the dominant issuer-specific component (page ranges A1-A3) is DERIVABLE_FROM_DOCUMENT, and A4/A5 already prove generic derivation works for aliases and section types. A6 (page/year aliases) must be eliminated, not generalized.
